title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode5 Whenever

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make it an awesome session!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, do you still have a fever?
You're a bit flushed today too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? You have a fever, Saki?
Why didn't you stay home?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, no. I'm fine! It must be from the excitement of thinking about going to the observatory with you guys tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure that's all it is?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So let's get started! Come on!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... Okay, but tell us if you start feeling unwell.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's not have it end like that time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. We can always practice some other time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cut it out, you don't need to worry so much! I'm glowing with health, see?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you say so. But don't overwork yourself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Or maybe we should each practice on our own today? Then everybody can go at their own pace.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess we could do that. In that case—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh please! You don't have to make any accommodations for me! Let's stick with the original plan!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We already did a solo practice.
Now I want to play together with you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, if you're okay with this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, it was really smooth.
We kept in sync throughout.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've gotten really good at this, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You must have practiced a lot on your own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so happy about playing so well that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse me, Saki, but I need to see your forehead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It's nothing! It's normal for me to be a little warmer than most people...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hey, oww...! Don't squeeze my arm so hard, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's like that time when you fainted...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why, Saki? Why didn't you say anything?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How many times did I tell you to take it easy? Why do you always do this?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's because...
I really want to go to the observatory with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We can go whenever!
Your health is more important...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We can't go whenever!
I've missed out on so much of my life already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, are you okay?
Ichika, can you bring that chair over there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sit down, Saki.
I'll get you something cold to drink.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm thinking of walking Saki home once she feels a little better, if that's okay with you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for barging into your house and bossing you around...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No need to apologize. There's no one else in, and you helped me a lot. Thanks, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're quick to take charge and always know what to do in situations like this. It's pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have a younger brother, so I'm used to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry for causing you trouble again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not that, but...
Anyways, you rest up. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll talk when you feel better.
